scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build: pnpm run clean && tsc && node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; fs.cpSync('prompts', 'dist/prompts', { recursive: true })"
scripts.test: pnpm run build && node --test gondolin-operations.test.mjs task-vm-state.test.mjs gondolin/dev-image.test.mjs image-builder/manager.test.mjs
